active_features: Server-authoritative multiplayer combat and Cipher Core scoring
Canon-driven procedural sprites, ruined tiles, and ambient fog
Optional image assets with procedural rendering fallback
upcoming_features: Faction-specific character animation and combat effects
dev_notes: Client is split into small browser ES modules under public/src/. public/client.js is the master orchestrator. Procedural rendering remains active when optional files under public/assets/ are absent. Ajaye's segmented Cipher Sleeve is rendered on his anatomical left arm only; his right arm remains ordinary clothing and skin.
